title: CEXAKycCredential
description: CEXA-Kyc - the reusable retail identity check of the Crypto Exchange Association (demo), governed on both sides (EGF section 6). The sealed evidence bundle rides in the holder's wallet, digest-bound through evidenceDigest. For demonstration only.

fullName.description: Full legal name of the subject as verified by the original check

birthDate.description: Date of birth as a dateint (YYYYMMDD), so AnonCreds predicate proofs (age over 18) work without revealing the date

documentNumberHash.description: Salted hash of the identity document number, so re-binding can match a passport chip without disclosing the number

kycLevel.description: Level of the check performed (e.g. standard, enhanced)

screeningDate.description: Date of the AML screening as a dateint (YYYYMMDD)

provider.description: EGF-authorized IDV provider that performed the original check (Annex C)

evidenceDigest.description: Digest (SRI) of the sealed evidence bundle carried in the holder's wallet
